_comment: PROVENANCE MANIFEST. PyMuPDF is licensed AGPL-3.0 and is never bundled: the main process downloads the wheel for this platform only after the user accepts the licence disclosure in Settings > Tools, verifies sizeBytes and sha256 before extraction, and installs it under userData/addons/pdf/<version>. Digests and sizes come from the PyPI JSON API for PyMuPDF 1.27.2.2 (2026-09-22) and must appear in requirements-pdf-addon-lock.txt (tests/sidecar/test_pdf_addon_manifest.py). To update: bump requirements-pdf-addon.in, regenerate the lock, and copy filename/url/size/sha256 per platform from https://pypi.org/pypi/PyMuPDF/<version>/json.
